advances: The complete seven-point epigraph has exactly four strict finite local minima of its original cubic depth moment, in two reflected pairs with different active central caps. The lower-cap pair is globally minimizing. Its value is strictly below 8^{-2}, so the coefficient-one arithmetic moment claim fails even on this genuine epigraph. Horizontal symmetrization increases the moment near every symmetric score, and exact multiplicativity of the moment fails on its Cartesian square. Thus a general-source argument must accommodate asymmetric minima and the extra mass forced by product halfspaces; this is an obstruction to those sharper mechanisms, not to an unspecified positive dimension-uniform coefficient.

external_sources: None. The accepted finite-tilt gate `c3ede657c2f01110` is used only for its exclusion of tied traces at local minima and its finite attainment of the global minimum. All cap formulas, algebraic stationary-point computations, exact rational witnesses, deformation calculations, and product comparisons are established above.
statement:
Let
\[
A=\{(0,1),(0,2),(1,0),(1,1),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)\},\qquad
p_{a,b}(x,t)=\frac{e^{ax+bt}}{Z(a,b)},\qquad
Z(a,b)=\sum_{(x,t)\in A}e^{ax+bt}.
\]
Use the actual normalized closed-halfspace depth \(\tau_p\) and the original moment \(M_3(p)=\sum_{z\in A}p_z\tau_p(z)^3\). The parameter \((a,b)\) is exactly \(\boldsymbol\theta\) in accepted fact `c3ede657c2f01110`; no mass is selected, renormalized, or discounted.

Write \(r=e^{-|a|}\in(0,1]\) and \(v=e^b>0\), and define the shifted normalizer \(\mathcal Z=(1+v)(1+r+r^{-1})+v^{-1}\). Reflection in \(x=1\) changes \(a\) to \(-a\) and preserves the moment. For the representative \(a\ge0\), the unnormalized weights after division by \(e^{a+b}\) are, in the displayed order of \(A\),
\[
(r,rv,v^{-1},1,v,r^{-1},v/r).
\]
The five vertices have singleton minimizing traces. At \((1,2)\), the only inclusion-minimal traces are \(\{(0,2),(1,2)\}\) and \(\{(1,2),(2,2)\}\). At \((1,1)\), they are exactly
\[
\begin{aligned}
&\{(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)\},\quad
\{(1,0),(1,1),(2,1)\},\\
&\{(0,1),(0,2),(1,1),(1,2)\},\quad
\{(1,1),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)\}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Consequently the seven depths, multiplied by \(\mathcal Z\), are
\[
\bigl(r,rv,v^{-1},\delta,v(1+r),r^{-1},v/r\bigr),\qquad
\delta=1+r+\min\{v^{-1},v(1+r)\},
\]
and the exact moment for every affine score is
\[
M_3(p_{a,b})=
\frac{(1+v^4)(r^4+r^{-4})+v^{-4}+v^4(1+r)^3+\delta^3}
{\bigl((1+v)(1+r+r^{-1})+v^{-1}\bigr)^4}.
\tag{1}
\]

The following exact algebraic description specifies all local minima. Put \(\mathcal Z_0=r+v(1+v)(1+r+r^2)=rv\mathcal Z\), and define
\[
\begin{aligned}
T_+(r,v)&=(1+v^4)(1+r^8)v^4+r^4+r^4v^8(1+r)^3
+r^4v^4(1+r)^3(1+v)^3,\\
T_-(r,v)&=(1+v^4)(1+r^8)v^4+r^4+r^4v^8(1+r)^3
+r^4v\bigl(1+v(1+r)\bigr)^3.
\end{aligned}
\tag{2}
\]
Here \(+\) means the upper central cap, on \(v^2(1+r)<1\); \(-\) means the lower central cap, on \(v^2(1+r)>1\). The corresponding moment is \(F_\pm=T_\pm/\mathcal Z_0^4\).

For each sign, \((r_\pm,v_\pm)\) is the unique solution of
\[
\mathcal Z_0\partial_rT_\pm-4T_\pm\partial_r\mathcal Z_0=0,
\qquad
\mathcal Z_0\partial_vT_\pm-4T_\pm\partial_v\mathcal Z_0=0
\tag{3}
\]
in its open cap region with \(0<r<1\). These real algebraic solutions have the following rational isolating boxes and moment bounds:

| Central cap | Interval for \(r\) | Interval for \(v\) | Interval for \(F_\pm\) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Upper | \((51204/10^5,51208/10^5)\) | \((70147/10^5,70152/10^5)\) | \((1397/10^5,1398/10^5)\) |
| Lower | \((65018/10^5,65023/10^5)\) | \((118478/10^5,118483/10^5)\) | \((1129/10^5,1130/10^5)\) |

All four local minima are strict and occur at \((a,b)=(\pm\log r_+,\log v_+)\) and \((\pm\log r_-,\log v_-)\). The lower pair gives the global minimum. In particular the upper pair has \(b<0\), so the phenomenon includes downward vertical scores. Any coefficient \(\kappa\) valid in \(M_3\ge\kappa8^{-N}\) for every complete log-affine support must satisfy \(\kappa\le64F_-<452/625\).

The exact rational tilt \((a,b)=(\log(5/3),\log(6/5))\) gives
\[
M_3(p_{a,b})=\frac{24045935231}{2094413889681}<\frac1{64}.
\tag{4}
\]
The untilted law has \(M_3(p_{0,0})=40/2401\), and \(a=0\) is never a local minimum for any \(b\).

Finally, let \(p=p_{a,b}\) with \(a\ne0\) and \(v^2(1+r)\ne1\), and use the actual halfspace depth in \(\mathbb R^4\) on \(A\times A\). Then
\[
\tau_{p\otimes p}((1,1),(1,1))>\tau_p(1,1)^2,
\qquad
M_3(p\otimes p)>M_3(p)^2.
\tag{5}
\]
Thus (4) cannot be promoted to a dimension-uniform counterexample by asserting exact moment tensorization.
